csv_project_name: Design for E. 55th Street Safe Routes to School Quick Build
csv_scope_of_work: Services include the preparation of construction contract plans and specifications for a quick-build roadway reallocation along approximately 2.5 miles of E. 55th Street, from Outhwaite Avenue to North Marginal Road. This project excludes the 0.3-mile segment of SR 283 on E. 55th Street between Superior and St. Clair Avenues. ODOT Safe Routes to School funds, in combination with other local funds, will finance this improvement. The City will administer the design phase and ODOT District 12 will administer the construction phase of this project. The E. 55th Street Safe Routes to School project focuses on enhancing safety, comfort, and mobility along the corridor through a quick-build approach. This project will reallocate existing curb-to-curb space to add a twoway center turn lane and separated bike lanes on both sides of the road. Improvements also include ladder-style crosswalk striping at existing crossings, the installation of RRFBs or PHBs, and new crosswalk striping where demand or significant gaps exist. To improve transit accessibility, the project will install concrete ADA landing pads at bus stops consistent with GCRTA design guidelines. Design elements must align with the City s commitment to Vision Zero, prioritizing the reduction of fatal and serious injury crashes as a key outcome. No pavement rehabilitation is included in this scope. The segment of E. 55th Street within SR 283 (Superior Avenue to St. Clair Avenue) will be rehabilitated under a separate project.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Materials Testing, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
